selector.rationale: The presence of a firm, mildly tender diffuse swelling and fluctuations in pain intensity supports the diagnosis of periapical abscess, which is further strengthened by the panoramic radiography demonstrating a mild periapical radiolucency and the extraction yielding a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue.

rejected.label: Periapical granuloma
rejected.why: While the histopathological examination was sent with a provisional diagnosis of periapical granuloma, the clinical presentation and radiographic findings more strongly support the diagnosis of periapical abscess.
